button.label: Heading 1
button.supertip: Applies the configured Heading 1 style to the selection.

button.label: Heading 2
button.supertip: Applies the configured Heading 2 style to the selection.

button.label: Heading 3
button.supertip: Applies the configured Heading 3 style to the selection.

button.label: Normal Text
button.supertip: Applies the configured Normal text style to the selection.

button.label: Show in Notebook Tree
button.supertip: Expands and selects this page in OneNote's navigation pane.

button.label: Collapse the Notebook Tree
button.supertip: Folds every notebook, section group and section in OneNote's navigation pane.

dynamicMenu.label: Language
dynamicMenu.supertip: The list comes from the language registry in OneNoteMomtion.Core. Picking one formats the selection straight away - including when it is the same language as before.

button.label: Disable Spellcheck
button.supertip: Gives the selected text a language with no dictionary, which makes the red underlines disappear.

button.label: Enable Spellcheck
button.supertip: Undoes the forced language and restores spell checking.

button.label: Reformat Page
button.supertip: Puts the configured styles onto every heading and paragraph, tidies whitespace and blank paragraphs, and refreshes the code blocks. One Ctrl+Z takes all of it back.

button.label: Settings
button.supertip: Opens the style editor in the floating palette.
